tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List connected desktops with deviceId and readable deviceName. Use deviceId to target other tools; names are display labels and may not be unique.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a device's screen and return the image plus coordinate metadata. Defaults to the primary display (crisp, native 1:1). Use target=display with displayId, target=window with windowId (both from get_window_list/prior screenshot), or target=virtual for all monitors. Map an image pixel to a screen coordinate with coordinateSpace: screenX = coordinateSpace.screenX + imageX * scaleX (scaleX = 1 unless downscaled). Pass that screen coordinate to the mouse tool.

deviceId.description: Target deviceId from list_devices; not the readable deviceName

target.description: primary display (default), all monitors (virtual), a specific display, or a window

displayId.description: Stable display id from displays[].displayId; required when target=display

windowId.description: Window id (hex handle) from get_window_list; required when target=window

detail.description: Detail level; the server picks encoding and resolution (high = native PNG, crisp text)

tools.name: mouse
tools.description: Control a device's mouse. Coordinates are absolute screen pixels — take an image pixel from a screenshot and map it with coordinateSpace: screenX = coordinateSpace.screenX + imageX * scaleX (identity when not downscaled). action=move/click use x,y; scroll uses amount with optional x,y; drag goes from x,y to toX,toY.

deviceId.description: Target deviceId from list_devices; not the readable deviceName

x.description: X pixel — move/click target, scroll point, or drag start

y.description: Y pixel — move/click target, scroll point, or drag start

tools.name: keyboard
tools.description: Send keyboard input to a device. action=type sends the literal text; action=press taps a key combination together (e.g. Ctrl+S).

deviceId.description: Target deviceId from list_devices; not the readable deviceName

action.description: type = literal text; press = key combo

keys.description: Keys to press together when action=press, e.g. ["ctrl", "s"]

tools.name: get_window_list
tools.description: List all visible windows with titles and positions on a specific device

deviceId.description: Target deviceId from list_devices; not the readable deviceName

tools.name: cmd
tools.description: Run a CMD command through WinPTY on the Windows WPF tool service. Requires local CMD opt-in. Each call starts a fresh shell as the signed-in user. Output is terminal text, possibly including ANSI escapes. Do not use for interactive prompts or long-running servers.

deviceId.description: Target deviceId from list_devices; not the readable deviceName

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Read a file from the Windows tool service device and return it as base64. Absolute Windows path required. Files larger than 10 MB are rejected.

deviceId.description: Target deviceId from list_devices; not the readable deviceName

path.description: Absolute path to the file on the device
